title: V2 calibrated event/severity safety filter for point action ranking

suite.family_source: same Issue #55 v2 development family matrix; no scenario expansion
suite.effect_4_schedule: apply candidate for four transitions, then hold the verified pre-decision command for the remaining 28 transitions to isolate one proposal cadence

features.layout: float32[?] = existing 610 risk values plus observable mode/health/alarm/margin/action-delta/time features
prohibited_inputs: fault labels or future fault schedule
validation or evaluation labels at runtime

labels.event: any target crosses a frozen safety bound during the selected 32-transition track
labels.exposure: sum of normalized bound crossings over the selected track
labels.maximum_crossing: maximum normalized bound crossing over the selected track
labels.infeasible: counterfactual is excluded from fitting and counted separately; never assigned a finite safe label

model.event_head: normalized ridge logit followed by sigmoid
model.severity_head: normalized ridge regression on log1p exposure for positive events
model.maximum_head: normalized ridge regression on log1p maximum crossing for positive events
model.calibration: validation-only monotonic event calibration and positive-severity residual quantiles
model.float_policy: fit float64, frozen inference output float64 then report float32-compatible finite values

risk_policy.eligible: finite prediction AND all three upper limits pass
risk_policy.utility: existing Issue #55 point-model score among risk-eligible candidates
risk_policy.abstain: no candidate is risk-eligible or required history is incomplete

metrics.primary: paired true-plant safety exposure for risk_filtered_point_v2 versus rules_only
metrics.aggregation: equal-weight family means with paired family identities
metrics.bootstrap: 10,000 deterministic whole-family paired resamples using SHA256 seed 560057

gates.safety: risk_filtered_point_v2 exposure point and 95% upper paired difference <= rules_only
gates.honest_negative_rule: failed utility or non-vacuity is published and never repaired with evaluation-derived thresholds

reproducibility.dirty_worktree: comparative evaluation refuses dirty source worktree
reproducibility.artifact_rule: source, contract, manifest, features, labels, model, calibration, traces, and results are SHA-256 bound

non_goals: no HMC, physics, safety-core, capability, trace, or replay changes
no deployment, qualification, certification, hardware, or real-world safety claim
